name: Koma Manga
description: Koma Manga — a manga artist portfolio theme set like a poster: a paper header with the studio name and a Request a commission button, whose menu runs down a fixed sumi side rail on wide screens (stacked vertical words in Chinese and Japanese). Wakatake young-bamboo green (#68BE8D) is the main colour: the hero, every page head and the serial band are bamboo-green fields with sumi-ink type. The hero is centred giant type over a collage of tilted clay-diorama panels taped onto screen-tone pieces; a cut-out clay artist leaps out of the collage and over the hero edge, a cut-out dip pen breaks out of the serial band's desk panel and over its top edge, and a clay cat peeks over every page head. Every picture is a 3D clay illustration. Selected works are laid out like a manga page, the process as a four-panel strip. Zen Old Mincho for display, Golos Text for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-24 (poster-typographic, centered-giant-type hero, side-rail nav, collage, 3d-clay, wakatake #68BE8D, Zen Old Mincho + Golos Text). A full top header (studio name, menu, Request a commission button) whose menu runs down a fixed left side rail from 1100 px (numbered; stacked vertical words in Chinese and Japanese, overlay menu on small screens). Every picture is a 3D clay illustration generated with Grok Build; collage = tilted clay-diorama panels with tape over cut screen-tone and paper pieces in the hero, works laid out as a manga page, the process as a four-panel strip. Break-frame: the cut-out clay artist (transparent WebP) leaps out of the hero collage, over the giant type's field and across the hero's bottom edge into the studio board; the cut-out dip pen breaks out of the tilted desk panel and over the serial band's top edge; the cut-out clay cat peeks over the bottom edge of every page head. Sample content in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: sumi ink #10231A on wakatake #68BE8D 7.3:1 (all text on the hero, page heads, serial band and the phone menu); ink on paper #F3F8F4 15.3:1; deep bamboo #24653F on paper 6.5:1 (links, labels); moss grey #4A5D52 on paper 6.6:1 (secondary text); ink on pale bamboo #D3EEDD 13.3:1 (price and details cards); sprout #A8DDBC on ink 10.8:1 (board labels); wakatake on ink 7.3:1 (footer name, rail numbers; ink on wakatake buttons 7.3:1); paper on ink 15.3:1 (rail, board, footer); white on ink buttons 16.4:1; seal red #C8372D on paper 4.8:1 and on white 5.2:1 (small bold facts labels); white on seal red 5.2:1 (chapter stamp); white on wakatake only 2.3:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 若竹綠的漫畫家作品集：海報式置中巨大標題、黏土場景拼貼，去背黏土人物衝出畫格；側欄選單，樣本內容含五種語言。
summary.en: A bamboo-green manga portfolio: giant centred poster type over a clay-diorama collage, with a cut-out clay artist leaping out.
summary.ja: 若竹色の漫画家ポートフォリオ。中央の大きな文字、粘土ジオラマのコラージュ、枠を飛び出す切り抜きの粘土人形。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un portfolio de manga vert bambou : grand titre centré façon affiche, collage de dioramas en pâte et mangaka détourée qui en jaillit.
summary.de: Ein bambusgrünes Manga-Portfolio: riesige zentrierte Plakatschrift, Collage aus Knete-Dioramen und ein herausspringender Freisteller.
